import * as THREE from 'three';
import {faceTriplanarUV} from './shapes.js';

// Explicit reversible engineering fit. Photographs establish a front vault and
// two ascents, not these coordinates, step counts or individual rock surfaces.
export function duixiuMountainProfile({center,radiusX=12.545,radiusZ=8.305,topY=10}){
 if(!center?.isVector3||![center.x,center.y,center.z,radiusX,radiusZ,topY].every(Number.isFinite)||radiusX<12||radiusZ<8||topY<9)throw Error('Duixiu requires its bounded retained mountain envelope');
 const route=(id,raw)=>{const points=[raw[0]],radius=1.6;for(let i=1;i<raw.length-1;i++){const a=raw[i-1],b=raw[i],c=raw[i+1],u=new THREE.Vector2(a[0]-b[0],a[1]-b[1]).normalize(),v=new THREE.Vector2(c[0]-b[0],c[1]-b[1]).normalize(),r=Math.min(radius,Math.hypot(a[0]-b[0],a[1]-b[1])*.45,Math.hypot(c[0]-b[0],c[1]-b[1])*.45),center=new THREE.Vector2(b[0],b[1]).addScaledVector(u,r).addScaledVector(v,r),start=new THREE.Vector2(b[0],b[1]).addScaledVector(u,r).sub(center),end=new THREE.Vector2(b[0],b[1]).addScaledVector(v,r).sub(center),aa=Math.atan2(start.y,start.x),delta=Math.atan2(start.cross(end),start.dot(end));for(let k=0;k<=12;k++){const angle=aa+delta*k/12;points.push([center.x+r*Math.cos(angle),center.y+r*Math.sin(angle)]);}}points.push(raw.at(-1));let length=0;const distances=[0];for(let i=1;i<points.length;i++){length+=Math.hypot(points[i][0]-points[i-1][0],points[i][1]-points[i-1][1]);distances.push(length);}return{id,width:1.8,solidShoulder:.3,points:points.map(([x,z],i)=>[x,(topY+.5)*Math.min(1,distances[i]/(length-.9)),z]),length,maximumGrade:(topY+.5)/(length-.9)};};
 return{status:'PHOTO_TOPOLOGY_ENGINEERING_FIT_NOT_SURVEY',accepted:false,source:'https://www.dpm.org.cn/explore/building/236429.html',center:center.toArray(),radiusX,radiusZ,topY,summitY:topY+.5,cellSize:.25,stepRise:.1,cave:{halfWidth:1.5,frontZ:-7.8,rearZ:-3.3,springY:2,crownY:3,floorY:.02,rearClosed:true},routes:[route('east',[[-10.3,-7.35],[-10.3,6.4],[-5.7,6.4],[-5.7,-2.2],[-3.7,-2.2]]),route('west',[[10.4,-7.35],[10.4,6.7],[5.6,6.7],[5.6,-1.7],[3.7,-1.7]])],unknown:['Exact stonework, individual step count and survey coordinates','Cave decorative inventory, inscriptions and fountain apparatus','Upper pavilion interior/access not reconstructed']};
}
function closestRoute(p,x,z){let best=null;for(const route of p.routes)for(let i=1;i<route.points.length;i++){const a=route.points[i-1],b=route.points[i],dx=b[0]-a[0],dz=b[2]-a[2],t=THREE.MathUtils.clamp(((x-a[0])*dx+(z-a[2])*dz)/(dx*dx+dz*dz),0,1),d=Math.hypot(x-a[0]-dx*t,z-a[2]-dz*t);if(!best||d<best.distance)best={distance:d,y:a[1]+(b[1]-a[1])*t,route:route.id};}return best;}
function heightAt(p,x,z){const t=1-(x/p.radiusX)**2-(z/p.radiusZ)**2;let h=t>0?p.topY*Math.pow(t,.45):0;const inner=Math.abs(x)<=2.8&&Math.abs(z)<=2.8,apron=Math.abs(x)<=4.6&&Math.abs(z)<=4.6;if(apron)h=inner?p.topY:p.summitY;const r=closestRoute(p,x,z);if(!inner&&r.distance<=1.2)h=r.y;if(Math.abs(x)<2&&z>=p.cave.frontZ&&z<p.cave.rearZ)h=Math.max(h,3.6);if(Math.abs(x)<1.8&&z<p.cave.frontZ)h=0;return Math.max(0,Math.round(h/p.stepRise)*p.stepRise);}
function coordinates(radius,extras){const set=new Set([-radius,radius,...extras.filter(v=>Math.abs(v)<radius)]);for(let v=-Math.floor(radius*4)/4;v<radius;v+=.25)set.add(v);return[...set].sort((a,b)=>a-b);}
function finishGeometry(g,tile){let flat=g.index?g.toNonIndexed():g;if(flat!==g)g.dispose();flat=faceTriplanarUV(flat,tile);const p=flat.attributes.position,c=new Float32Array(p.count*3);for(let i=0;i<p.count;i++){const shade=.72+.13*Math.sin(p.getX(i)*2.7+p.getZ(i)*1.9)+.07*Math.cos(p.getY(i)*4.1);c.set([shade,shade*.99,shade*.95],i*3);}flat.setAttribute('color',new THREE.BufferAttribute(c,3));return flat;}
// Merge only exactly adjacent equal-height rectangles. No convex hull or
// enlargement across a cave, riser, or absent cell is permitted.
function compactBoxes(boxes){let current=boxes;for(const axis of ['x','z','x','z']){const other=axis==='x'?'z':'x',groups=new Map(),out=[];for(const b of current){if(b.overhead){out.push(b);continue;}const key=[b.min.y,b.max.y,b.min[other],b.max[other]].join('|');if(!groups.has(key))groups.set(key,[]);groups.get(key).push(b);}for(const group of groups.values()){group.sort((a,b)=>a.min[axis]-b.min[axis]);let last=null;for(const b of group){if(last&&Math.abs(last.max[axis]-b.min[axis])<1e-10)last.max[axis]=b.max[axis];else{last=b.clone();out.push(last);}}}current=out;}return current;}
export function buildDuixiuMountain(options){const p=duixiuMountainProfile(options),[cx,cy,cz]=p.center,tile=options.tile??3,geometries=[],caps=[],colliders=[],walkables=[],cells=[],xs=coordinates(p.radiusX,[-2.8,2.8,-1.5,1.5,-4.6,4.6]),zs=coordinates(p.radiusZ,[-2.8,2.8,-4.6,4.6,p.cave.frontZ,p.cave.rearZ]);
 const addSupport=(x0,x1,z0,z1,h)=>walkables.push({type:'box',rescue:false,box:new THREE.Box3(new THREE.Vector3(cx+x0,cy+h,cz+z0),new THREE.Vector3(cx+x1,cy+h,cz+z1))});
 for(let i=1;i<xs.length;i++)for(let j=1;j<zs.length;j++){const x0=xs[i-1],x1=xs[i],z0=zs[j-1],z1=zs[j],x=(x0+x1)/2,z=(z0+z1)/2,h=heightAt(p,x,z);if(h<.05)continue;const cave=x0>=-1.5&&x1<=1.5&&z0>=p.cave.frontZ&&z1<=p.cave.rearZ;let g,box;
  if(cave){const points=[];for(let k=0;k<=4;k++){const xx=x0+(x1-x0)*k/4,yy=p.cave.springY+Math.sqrt(Math.max(0,1-(xx/1.5)**2));points.push([xx,yy]);}const shape=new THREE.Shape();shape.moveTo(points[0][0],points[0][1]);points.slice(1).forEach(q=>shape.lineTo(...q));shape.lineTo(x1,h-.1);shape.lineTo(x0,h-.1);shape.closePath();g=new THREE.ExtrudeGeometry(shape,{depth:z1-z0,bevelEnabled:false});g.translate(cx,cy,cz+z0);const min=Math.min(...points.map(q=>q[1]));box=new THREE.Box3(new THREE.Vector3(cx+x0,cy+min,cz+z0),new THREE.Vector3(cx+x1,cy+h-.1,cz+z1));box.overhead={type:'piecewise-linear-x',sourceId:'duixiu-front-vault-fit',points:points.map(([x,y])=>[cx+x,cy+y]),minZ:cz+z0,maxZ:cz+z1,topY:cy+h-.1};const cap=new THREE.BoxGeometry(x1-x0,.1,z1-z0);cap.translate(cx+x,cy+h-.05,cz+z);caps.push(finishGeometry(cap,tile));colliders.push(new THREE.Box3(new THREE.Vector3(cx+x0,cy+h-.1,cz+z0),new THREE.Vector3(cx+x1,cy+h,cz+z1)));
  }else{g=new THREE.BoxGeometry(x1-x0,h,z1-z0);g.translate(cx+x,cy+h/2,cz+z);box=new THREE.Box3(new THREE.Vector3(cx+x0,cy,cz+z0),new THREE.Vector3(cx+x1,cy+h,cz+z1));}
  // A downstream exact replacement may need only this old cell's real
  // Float32 source bounds. Keep original BoxGeometry quantization, but avoid
  // normals/UV/color expansion that would be immediately discarded.
  const sourceOnly = !cave && options.sourceOnlyCell && (g.computeBoundingBox(), options.sourceOnlyCell({x0,x1,z0,z1}, g.boundingBox));
  if (sourceOnly) { g.userData.duixiuSourceOnly = true; geometries.push(g); }
  else geometries.push(finishGeometry(g,tile));
  colliders.push(box);addSupport(x0,x1,z0,z1,h);cells.push({x0,x1,z0,z1,top:h,cave,route:closestRoute(p,x,z).distance<=.9?closestRoute(p,x,z).route:null});
 }
 geometries.push(...caps);
 const floor=new THREE.BoxGeometry(3,p.cave.floorY,p.cave.rearZ+p.radiusZ);floor.translate(cx,cy+p.cave.floorY/2,cz+(p.cave.rearZ-p.radiusZ)/2);geometries.push(finishGeometry(floor,tile));addSupport(-1.5,1.5,-p.radiusZ,p.cave.rearZ,p.cave.floorY);
 // The retained real pavilion platform (rendered by GardenBuilder) is .5m thick.
 addSupport(-2.8,2.8,-2.8,2.8,p.summitY);
 return{geometries,colliders:compactBoxes(colliders),walkables:compactBoxes(walkables.map(w=>w.box)).map(box=>({type:'box',rescue:false,box})),topY:p.topY,profile:{...p,cells,solidCellCount:cells.length,...(options.sourceOnlyCell?{sourceOnlyGeometryCount:geometries.filter(g=>g.userData.duixiuSourceOnly).length}:{})}};
}
